enchantments.tooltip: Shatter +15: This effect gives a +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.
Insightful Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Combat Mastery +5: +5 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Improved Earthen Guard: When you are successfully attacked, there is a 15% chance that a Stone Skin will be cast on you.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
